title: Code Editor Prepaint Planner Cost v1
problem: After edge-row payload prebuild, the remaining resize tail cost is concentrated in replay-plan construction. The code editor still scans all visible rows and validates replay context in prepaint, which keeps us_row_scene_prepaint_plan visible in the worst bundle.

repro.summary: Run the code-editor resize probes with paint attribution enabled and confirm the replay planner stays hit-only while `us_row_scene_prepaint_plan` drops from the closed lane baseline.
commands: target/release/fretboard-dev diag perf ui-code-editor-resize-probes --repeat 3 --warmup-frames 5 --reuse-launch --prewarm-script tools/diag-scripts/_prelude/tooling-suite-prewarm-fonts.json --prelude-script tools/diag-scripts/_prelude/tooling-suite-prelude-reset-diagnostics.json --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_VIEW_CACHE=1 --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_VIEW_CACHE_SHELL=1 --env FRET_DIAG_SCRIPT_AUTO_DUMP=0 --env FRET_DIAG_SEMANTICS=0 --env FRET_CODE_EDITOR_DIAG_PAINT_PERF=1 --sort time --top 15 --json --perf-baseline docs/workstreams/perf-baselines/ui-code-editor-resize-probes.macos-m4.v2.json --dir target/fret-diag/code-editor-prepaint-planner-cost-v1-after-fast-replay-context-counts-20260515 --launch -- cargo run -p fret-ui-gallery --release --features gallery-full

gates.name: focused-replay-plan
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-code-editor prepaint_row_scene_replay_plan --features syntax-rust --no-fail-fast
